distribution: Manfeilong, Jinghong, Yunnan, 640 m above sea level.
soldier: Head yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part pale yellow, labrum yellow, antennae milk-white tinged with smoky, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow. The dorsum of the head with scattered long hairs, the labrum with a pair of apical hairs and the sides with four longitudinal rows of hairs; the margin of the anterior half of the pronotum with long and short hairs alternating, the posterior half and the lateral margins with sparse long hairs. Small soldier: head colour slightly paler than in the large soldier, abdomen and legs the same colour as in the large soldier; the small tooth in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible lies closer to the basal tooth than does the small tooth at the same site in the large soldier.
taxonomy_note: The genus field in the original work is defective, only the letters Anc surviving; the genus is in fact Ancistrotermes, and the genus name is unchanged on this site.
